dialogues.speaker: Juliette
dialogues.text: Alas! *sobs* O misfortunate stroll! I should ne'er have suggested thee.

dialogues.speaker: Juliette
dialogues.text: A bosom friend and I did'st walk about these parts, but by hilichurls were set upon...

dialogues.speaker: Juliette
dialogues.text: They have taken him. My friend was taken in my defense!

dialogues.speaker: Juliette
dialogues.text: I did not see them clearly, but I am sure they are on this island still. *sobs* Oh, what is to be done?
